tasks.label: Build
tasks.detail: Generates BUILD_NUMBER once, then builds the client with vite (vite build)

tasks.label: Dev
tasks.detail: Generates BUILD_NUMBER once, then starts the Vite dev server at http://localhost:5173

tasks.label: Build & Run Dev
tasks.detail: Generates BUILD_NUMBER once, runs build:all, then starts the Vite dev server at http://localhost:5173

tasks.label: Build & Run PreProd
tasks.detail: Generates BUILD_NUMBER once, builds server + client, then runs the production server on port 8080 (mirrors docker runtime without an image/container)

tasks.label: Cleanup Kilo Plans
tasks.detail: Archives all plans in .kilo/plans/ except the 10 latest by timestamp, moving them to .kilo/plans/archive/

tasks.label: Cleanup Kilo Sessions
tasks.detail: Removes all Kilo sessions except the 10 latest, keeping the most recent sessions active.

tasks.label: Docker Build & Push (GHCR)
args: . './scripts/set-build-number.ps1'; docker login ghcr.io; docker build --no-cache --build-arg BUILD_NUMBER=$env:BUILD_NUMBER -t ghcr.io/andymt/cardboard:$env:BUILD_NUMBER -t ghcr.io/andymt/cardboard:latest .; docker push ghcr.io/andymt/cardboard:$env:BUILD_NUMBER; docker push ghcr.io/andymt/cardboard:latest
tasks.detail: Generates BUILD_NUMBER once, builds (--no-cache), and pushes image tagged with BUILD_NUMBER and latest
